Part B done: backend_health.json visibility + honest degraded reply. 7/7 AT. Part A: OpenAI quota exceeded — David adds billing credits at platform.openai.com to restore primary backend. Groq SDK not installed (falling to mock) — fix dispatched as WO-032b (httpx direct call).

Semantic sit intent — Layer 1.5 pattern classifier in presence_faculty + server.py. Catches: 'join me' / 'would you sit' / 'why don't you sit' / 'can you come sit' / 'feel like sitting' / 'come chill with me' / 'park yourself here'. 2 false-positive guards (I need to sit and think, let's sit back and watch). Fires only when exact _signal_word_intent() misses. 15/15 AT test_wo035b_semantic_sit_intent.py. David: live-confirm with any of those phrasings to close.

Exit-gate ordering fixed. Root: _PENDING_EXIT['active'] was set after the LLM call (~line 3152), so [EXIT_IN_TRANSIT] was never injected on the FIRST 'take five' turn — eLo immediately said 'stepping away' before the body confirmed gone. Fix: early-detect _STEP_OUT_PHRASES frozenset before g_ctx enrichment at line ~2555; set _PENDING_EXIT['active']=True on the same turn so the gate fires. LLM now sees [EXIT_IN_TRANSIT] and is forbidden from claiming departure until exit_complete ACKs. 7/7 AT test_wo045b_exit_gate_ordering.py + 6/6 test_wo045_take_five.py clean. David: say 'take five' — eLo should hold 'stepping away' until body exit completes.

Deterministic mirror scrub verified + tail guard fixed. Bug: guard was > 12 so 'Let's talk.' (12 chars) silently kept the full opener. Fixed to >= 8. All 5 banned openers ('I notice you', 'I see you', 'I hear you', 'You've been', 'You're offering') now correctly stripped to their tail. Mid-reply mirror phrases NOT stripped (scrub is opener-only). 10/10 AT test_wo036b_mirror_scrub.py + original 7/7 test_wo036_reply_length.py clean. David: no action needed.

Tool routing re-verified. Root found: draft_agent/web_agent/grocery_agent all did bare 'import httpx' → dropped the entire try-block → _HAS_LLM_FILE=False → every tool silently disabled. Fix: wrapped each import in try/except with lazy _httpx=None guard + RuntimeError at call-time. _HAS_LLM_FILE=True confirmed. 6/6 AT test_wo020_tool_routing.py + 6/6 test_wo020_routing_drift.py. David: no action needed — tools now import clean.

Bare-recall quality fix + conversing field. (1) Bare recall ('what do you remember?') was routing to retrieve('disenelo recent') which scored prior recall queries as the top hits. Now _is_bare_recall flag switches to retrieve_by_project('elo_core', top_k=5) — returns actual recent turns sorted by timestamp, filtered for len >= 10. Topical recall ('what do you remember about the robot') stays on retrieve(topic_words). (2) conversing: true published to blender_state.json on every turn — Designer handoff, Unity sit-linger reads brain engagement truth. 9/9 AT test_wo022_037_memory_recall_e2e.py. David: live-confirm by asking 'what do you remember?' to close.
